author: nknuson
body: For t9 I would just look for any gear with ward you can equip, you just missed last months even that had a lot of good t9 gear from Balin, maybe see if anyone has some spawned you could kill. Idk how that works on aetheric. As far as abilities, just full buff resists and attack ups and spam warriors pavane, that's all there really is to nyx until you get t10 and better gear.

author: petr1petr
body:
you can go 2 basic ways - normal way, or swash.

swash needs next to no def in order to increase dmg. 

normal way, is to build ward, def, res, so that you can survive.

Pavane is great dmg skill and comes from specialization, so I would first aim for "normal" build with pavane.

just buff and go. do not use gait of hildr - it will reduce your dmg.

"world bosses" - I suppose, that you mean raids? as you should not have any issues with bosses. The fact is, that summoner classline is best for these - and you mentioned buggane - thats the fastest and safe way. This will change later in T10.

as for gears - there are various guides for classes - this post has various links - including summoners guide, swash guide and realm guide: [https://www.reddit.com/r/OrnaRPG/comments/1kep7w1/compendium\_of\_guides\_to\_master\_orna/](https://www.reddit.com/r/OrnaRPG/comments/1kep7w1/compendium_of_guides_to_master_orna/)
